name: BLADE-DiceCE (epsilon ladder, Dice-CE objective only)
description: The BLADE ascending-epsilon ladder run on dice_ce_loss alone: one Auto-PGD run per reporting epsilon, each warm-started from the rung below, so every reported budget is optimised natively instead of projected down from the largest. One of the three per-objective marginals of blade, alongside blade_boundary and blade_frontier. Costs the same as a native per-epsilon single-objective arm and is the budget-matched comparator for pgd, a_pgd, auto_pgd, segpgd and cospgd. The arm key stays blade1 so the committed results remain addressable.
